# Cite.Me

> Cite.Me is a comprehensive citation tool that automates bibliography generation and citation formatting across APA, MLA, and Chicago styles.

Cite.Me provides an easy-to-use platform for students and researchers to generate properly formatted citations and bibliographies. The tool supports multiple citation styles and offers widget customization and website integration options for seamless citation management.

## Key Topics

- Citation Styles
- APA Format
- MLA Format
- Chicago Style
- Bibliography Generation
- Citation Tool
- Widget Customization
- Website Integration
- Citation Management
- Academic Writing

## Core Citation Tool

- [Cite.Me](https://www.cite.me): Homepage for Cite.Me citation tool supporting APA, MLA, Chicago styles
